title: PPIA-16 Integrated Screen / Workflow Reference Cases

cases.scenario: Recover one exact unfinished operation from repository continuity
cases.oracle: Newer internally consistent branch/checkpoint state controls unfinished recovery; lifecycle remains in_progress. Source stack shows stale pointer/compact projection and exact branch/checkpoint identity; no conversation-history substitution. Continuity conflict blocks unrelated mutation until reconciled.
cases.accessibility: Keyboard/nonvisual recovery announces work identity, raw lifecycle state, blocker count and next action; phone/200% reflow keeps authority and stop conditions visible.
forbidden: runtime or STAGE-A-A2 activation by PPIA-16

cases.scenario: Resolve repository readiness, exact scope authority, findings and stop conditions
cases.oracle: Exact scope authority and stop conditions remain sourced; WARN is not BLOCK and PASS is not completion. Historical finding remains historical; DT results are bound to selected repo/ref. Only named current blockers or scope gaps disable proposal/execution.
cases.accessibility: WARN/BLOCK and finding ownership are textually distinct, keyboard navigable and not color-only; compact cards retain source/blocking effect.
forbidden: runtime or STAGE-A-A2 activation by PPIA-16

cases.scenario: Prepare a bounded AI/Codex task without promoting generated aid to authority
cases.oracle: Generated capsule is an aid only; READY_TO_EXECUTE/PREPARED state follows DT-003 prerequisites and explicit overwrite rules. Capsule embeds source paths, candidate/base and stop conditions and becomes stale after source advance. Regenerate/review after source advance; never execute from stale capsule.
cases.accessibility: PREPARED/READY_TO_EXECUTE and missing prerequisite are announced before export; mobile review keeps scope/stop conditions before handoff.
forbidden: runtime or STAGE-A-A2 activation by PPIA-16

cases.scenario: Verify, normalize and permission-project governed fixtures
cases.oracle: Fixture class/provenance owns whether verify/project may proceed; contradictory fixture is blocked, not repaired silently. Projection retains source/fixture digest, class and authoritative=false. Conflict must be corrected at source before projection/scenario reuse.
cases.accessibility: Fixture phases remain semantically ordered without hidden tabs; role-safe meaning is available without table/spatial dependence.
forbidden: runtime or STAGE-A-A2 activation by PPIA-16

cases.scenario: Run and replay a deterministic scenario without simulated authoritative mutation
cases.oracle: Read-only scenario PASS remains exact-input evidence; adapter mutation semantics remain external authority. Scenario and adapter operation identities are retained separately. Unknown adapter outcome freezes retry until owning status lookup returns applied/not-applied/unknown.
cases.accessibility: Ordered step evidence and recovery status are accessible without log auto-streaming; mobile never makes retry the primary unknown-status action.
forbidden: runtime or STAGE-A-A2 activation by PPIA-16

cases.scenario: Carry role-safe fixture/scenario evidence into permission-leak scanning
cases.oracle: Current DT-006 finding blocks supplied scan surface; historical input finding does not become a current blocker by existence alone. Finding rows preserve current/historical input digest without protected payload. Repair and rerun on current inputs are required; no severity downgrade.
cases.accessibility: Finding reading order is source → raw state → summary → scope → blocker effect → next action; mobile cards keep blocker/next action above details.
forbidden: runtime or STAGE-A-A2 activation by PPIA-16

cases.scenario: Bind UI evidence to one exact candidate and propagate its receipt
cases.oracle: Old candidate screenshots remain historical evidence but cannot satisfy selected candidate UI gate. Receipt card marks candidate mismatch and preserves original producer digest. Fresh capture/harvest or valid current evidence is required; synthetic tool-test image cannot substitute.
cases.accessibility: Capture metadata/attestation carries meaning independent of screenshot pixels; candidate relationship is in accessible name and compact card first region.
forbidden: runtime or STAGE-A-A2 activation by PPIA-16

cases.scenario: Ratchet design compliance while preserving legacy WARN debt
cases.oracle: Legacy WARN remains visible; new candidate violation BLOCKs ratchet. Finding fingerprint and candidate relationship remain exact. Repair under owning scope and rerun changed-since; do not flatten WARN/BLOCK.
cases.accessibility: Legacy WARN/new BLOCK are textual, keyboard filterable and never tooltip-only; mobile findings retain source locator.
forbidden: runtime or STAGE-A-A2 activation by PPIA-16

cases.scenario: Compile stable-ID traceability and exact-candidate proof without equating proof to completion
cases.oracle: Historical PROVEN relation remains historical; selected head is DECLARED/UNDECLARED according to its own structured graph. Exact candidate/evidence digest controls proof eligibility. Recompile/requery current source roots; proof never upgrades lifecycle completion.
cases.accessibility: UNDECLARED/DECLARED/PROVEN and candidate relationship are text; occurrences and structured relations are separately navigable.
forbidden: runtime or STAGE-A-A2 activation by PPIA-16

cases.scenario: Separate reference recovery/performance probes from product-adapter evidence and sourced budgets
cases.oracle: Reference probe PASS, adapter-backed product result and budget evaluation remain separate evidence classes. Receipt records plan, adapter/candidate and approved budget_source; no threshold is synthesized. Missing/failed adapter or budget remains BLOCK/FAIL per tool semantics and cannot be replaced by reference probe.
cases.accessibility: Timing units, threshold, budget source and violations are textual; charts are optional duplicates; adapter requirement stays adjacent on mobile.
forbidden: runtime or STAGE-A-A2 activation by PPIA-16

cases.scenario: Assemble exact-head CI and evidence receipts into gate eligibility without lifecycle promotion
cases.oracle: All-green hosted CI establishes one evidence condition only; completion eligibility still depends on all declared evidence kinds and owning lifecycle gate. Every receipt is exact-head bound and historical failures are labeled separately. Candidate change or missing evidence returns gate to incomplete; merge/signature cannot be preclaimed.
cases.accessibility: Success count is never the only indicator; missing/failed checks and candidate mismatch are announced, and compact layout separates CI success from missing evidence kind.
forbidden: runtime or STAGE-A-A2 activation by PPIA-16

cases.scenario: Triage a blocker, recover the smallest governed next action and preserve owner-only boundaries
cases.oracle: Repair result is a new candidate; all current-gate evidence is reevaluated; owner-gated deployment remains outside PPIA-16 authority. Old receipts/findings retain original candidate and become stale/historical; new head is explicit. No blind retry, no failure erasure, no owner autoexecution, and continuity conflict stops unrelated mutation.
cases.accessibility: Current versus historical finding, new candidate, owner gate and next action are ordered text; continuity conflict is never suppressed at compact size.
forbidden: runtime or STAGE-A-A2 activation by PPIA-16
